test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct superlative degree of comparison for the given sentence.

The money arrived when l (little) expected it.

options.text: The money arrived when I least expected it.
The money arrived when I less expected it.
The money arrived when I little expected it.
The money arrived when I expected it.

solution:
The correct answer is: **The money arrived when I least expected it**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• 'Least' is correct in this context because it is the **superlative form** of the adjective 'little'.
 
• In this sentence, 'least' is used to indicate the smallest amount of expectation.
 
• It is a comparative form used to compare the level of expectation with other times when the money was expected.
 
• The sentence means that the money arrived at a time when the speaker had the lowest level of expectation.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **The money arrived when I least expected it**.
